title: Russian drone attack kills 10 in Ukraine; child rescued from rubble
detail: BBC reports a Russian drone attack killed 10 people in Ukraine and that a child was rescued from rubble. Only the headline summary was available; location and weapons details are unverified.

title: Russia warns Ukraine of 'dangerous trend' after Libya and Baltic attacks
detail: Al Jazeera reports the Kremlin responded to a strike on a warship docked in Libya, warning Ukraine of a 'dangerous trend' after the Libya and Baltic attacks. Only the headline summary was available; attribution and details of the incidents are unverified.
